dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. Espaillat introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Financial Services

form.official-title: To prevent the breakup of families receiving certain Federal housing assistance, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Families Under One Roof Act of 2019.

section.header: Use of housing assistance by non-resident aliens

subsection.text: Paragraph (2) of section 214(b) of the Housing and Community Development Act of 1980 (42 U.S.C. 1436a(b)(2)) is amended by striking any and inserting the family shall be eligible for financial assistance and the amount of.
Subparagraph (A) of section 214(c)(1) of the Housing and Community Development Act of 1980 (42 U.S.C. 1436a(c)(1)(A)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in the first sentence, by striking the head of household or spouse and inserting any member; and

subparagraph.text: by striking a head of household and inserting such member; and
by striking the head of household each place such term appears and inserting such member.
